goal: Continuously build and test Guix release packages and codesigning environments in CI
Catch packaging errors, signing dependency issues, and toolchain runtime bugs before release engineering
agreement: Support because release-context CI catches build and packaging issues before merge (fanquake)
Unaddressed objection: CI lint tests fail on file permissions and shell locale, no author reply (hebasto)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it continuously validates release builds and signing setups before release time
Catches packaging defects early and unblocks CI coverage for static toolchains like #25573

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because it exercises unit and functional tests against actual release binaries on native runners
Mainly configures CI workflow execution rather than improving core test framework machinery
